output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the function where the totalSupply and balanceOf[_target] are increased without a check, allowing the owner to set these values to a very high amount, granting themselves arbitrary token balances.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the function where balanceOf[_from] is decreased, allowing the value to drop below zero, causing a denial of service to the affected accounts.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the function where balanceOf[_from] is decreased, allowing the value to drop below zero, causing a denial of service to the affected accounts.

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the function where totalSupply is decreased, allowing the value to drop below zero, causing a denial of service to the affected accounts.
